description:
Welcome to Home & Hardware Lab – The Manual for the Rest of Us.

Originally founded in 2018 as Home Battery Bank, this channel has evolved into a technical resource for the "unfixable." I provide high-detail solutions for small engines, home appliances, and power systems where the official manual falls short.

What we do in the Lab:

Mechanical Repair: Carburetor teardowns and mower maintenance.

Home Systems: Appliance repair (washers, dryers, dishwashers) and electrical safety.

Power Solutions: Deep dives into generator grounding and backup battery banks.

Hardware Reviews: Lab-testing tools and Amazon products to see if they actually hold up.

I don’t just show the fix; I test the limits so you don’t have to. If it’s broken, let’s make it work. If it’s running, let’s keep it that way.

Fix it. Maintain it. Make it work.

Visit the lab: HomeBatteryBank.com
(Note: Site update to Home & Hardware Lab coming soon!)
